video_title: Kevin Garnett gets real honest about navigating the streets 👀

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on Tim Grgurich and Ron Eskridge coaching at Nike camp
quotes.excerpt: Tim Grgurich and Ron Eskridge are one of the coaches that they brought to coach a team.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Garnett
text_blocks.text: So we went to Tim Grgurich. I am saying at that time, Tim Grgurich had Farias, so it is like how in the hell he catching you at the camp, but it is like he has his eyes on you.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: So him and Ron Eskridge are one of the coaches that they brought to coach a team. I am just so happen to be on his team. Me and Antoine Jamison. Wolf coached us.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Eskridge's intense individual training sessions at Nike camp
quotes.excerpt: Ron Eskridge take me to the side and we would do a whole another type of workout.
quotes.quote: After we would get done, Ron Eskridge would take me to the side and we would do a whole another type of workout. Jump hooks, just a whole bunch of stuff and I came back there like, holy shit. I wish I could be around that type of development every day.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett's high school expulsion and Ron Eskridge's mentorship
quotes.excerpt: The first person my mom called was Ron Eskridge.
quotes.quote: I ended up getting in trouble in some high school my 11th grade year and getting kicked out of school. The first person my mom called was Ron Eskridge because that was the only man that was calling me not every day, but he was like, hey man, you working on that jump hook? Hey, are you running the hills? How you getting your vertical? He would just be pushing me and talking to me about stuff that I should be developing on my own as a player.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Eskridge's advice on seeking out higher-level competition
quotes.excerpt: You need to come up north and play some north competition and it'll help your game.
quotes.quote: Ron Eskridge used to always say, you need to come up north and play some north competition and it will help your game. Plus I was going to five-star, I went to Big Star. I don't know if y'all know George Gervin. Shout out to Big George. Rest in peace to George. I was guarding that, he was George Gervin. So I was little guard, he was big guard.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett's early development through East Coast basketball camps
quotes.excerpt: I ran up through the whole East Coast, man, just playing.
quotes.quote: I ran up through the whole East Coast, man, just playing. I went to what was this, was it Boo Williams? Is that saying it right? It was George Gervin, five-star. Tony Squires, I don't know if y'all remember Tony Squires had a camp up in there, so I met Zenden. I called Zenden up there. We class, so all these little tournaments, I am just going to hoop. I don't even know, half the time I am driving, I am getting here, but when I got with them, bro, it was different.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett's mother's influence on his maturity and discipline
quotes.excerpt: She has a certain masculinity and a certain aura about herself that demands your respect.
quotes.quote: It was tough on how she did it. My mom was not a soft woman. She has a certain masculinity and a certain aura about herself that demands your respect at all times. So yeah, she walked me in midway. It was me, my little sister and her. And she made me take my little sister, take care of your little sister, turn back around and walk back through midway, left us in that bitch, boy.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett's decision to reach out to Farragut High School
quotes.excerpt: I made a collect call to Farragut High School and I asked for the teacher there.
quotes.quote: I made a collect call to Farragut High School and I asked for the teacher there. And I asked if William Nelson was there because I knew he had taught there and I told him I was at the airport and he came and got me. And that was the beginning of my journey to Chicago.
